clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister's birth in March 1995, within eighteen months: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November, you developing stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. Each shift sits near another's across the household.
